description: Healers trained in martial meditation and medicine.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: Spend Focus Point to heal creature 1d4 + WIS within 5 feet.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Unarmed strikes deal extra damage to undead and fiends.

features.name: Healing Meditation
features.description: Spend level Focus Points to cure disease/poison.

features.name: Ultimate Medicine
features.description: Spend Focus Points to revive dying allies.
